themes.name: 店員與服務人員常說的話

cards.ex: We have to check out of the hotel by 11 a.m.
cards.exz: 我們得在早上 11 點前退房。
cards.note: 另一個常用意思是「看看」：Check this out!

cards.ex: We checked in at the front desk around 3 p.m.
cards.exz: 我們下午 3 點左右在櫃台辦好入住。
cards.note: 機場辦登機、診所報到也用 check in。

cards.ex: My health insurance premium goes up again next year.
cards.exz: 我的健康保險保費明年又要漲了。
cards.note: 也有「高級的」意思：premium gas＝高級汽油。

cards.ex: I filed a claim with my insurance company after the accident.
cards.exz: 車禍後我向保險公司提出了理賠申請。
cards.note: 常搭配動詞 file：file a claim＝提出理賠申請。

cards.ex: Do you have a first aid kit in the car?
cards.exz: 你車上有急救箱嗎？
cards.note: 藥局和超市都買得到 first aid kit（急救箱）。

cards.ex: I have a $1,500 deductible on my health plan.
cards.exz: 我的健康保險有 1,500 美元的自付額。
cards.note: 要先付滿自付額，保險才開始理賠。

cards.ex: I lowkey want to skip the party tonight.
cards.exz: 我其實有點想跳過今晚的派對。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，淡淡的「其實有點…」；反義是 highkey。

cards.ex: Can you take out the trash before you leave?
cards.exz: 你出門前可以順便把垃圾拿去倒嗎？
cards.note: 外帶餐點寫成名詞 takeout：Let's order takeout.

cards.ex: Is it cool if I park here for a minute?
cards.exz: 我在這裡停一下沒關係吧？
cards.note: 回答 Cool. 或 We're cool. 表示「好啊」「沒事了」。

cards.ex: Our car broke down on the highway near Phoenix.
cards.exz: 我們的車在鳳凰城附近的高速公路上拋錨了。
cards.note: 人也能 break down：She broke down and cried.

cards.ex: Can you pick me up at the airport at 6 p.m.?
cards.exz: 你下午 6 點可以到機場接我嗎？
cards.note: 到店領取的訂單叫 pickup；小貨車也叫 pickup。

cards.ex: The heavy rain caused a flash flood downtown last night.
cards.exz: 昨晚大雨在市區造成了暴洪。
cards.note: 手機常跳出 Flash Flood Warning（暴洪警報）通知。

cards.ex: I have a reservation for two under Chen at 7:30.
cards.exz: 我用陳的名字訂了兩位，7 點半。
cards.note: 報訂位要說 under 加姓；飯店、租車預訂也用。

cards.ex: They had a fight, but they made up the next day.
cards.exz: 他們吵了一架，但隔天就和好了。
cards.note: 也指補課補考：make up a missed exam。

cards.ex: Can you back up a little? I can't get out.
cards.exz: 你可以往後倒一點嗎？我出不去。
cards.note: 備份檔案：back up your files；名詞 backup＝備份。

cards.ex: We ran out of milk, so I'm heading to Target.
cards.exz: 牛奶喝完了，我要去 Target 買。
cards.note: 更口語的說法：We're out of milk.

cards.ex: Can we get the check, please?
cards.exz: 麻煩幫我們結帳。
cards.note: 餐廳的 check 是帳單，英國說 bill；課本教的是「檢查」。

cards.ex: I'm not going to that party, period.
cards.exz: 我不去那個派對，就這樣。
cards.note: 口語，加在句尾，表示沒得討論。

cards.ex: We got to the airport early to get through security.
cards.exz: 我們提早到機場，好通過安檢。
cards.note: 也指保全人員；租屋押金叫 security deposit。

cards.ex: The savings account pays 4.5% interest a year.
cards.exz: 這個儲蓄帳戶一年的利息是 4.5%。
cards.note: 課本教「興趣」；銀行、房貸、信用卡的 interest 是利息。

cards.ex: I need to pay the electric bill by Friday.
cards.exz: 我星期五前要繳電費帳單。
cards.note: 紙鈔也叫 bill：a five-dollar bill；餐廳多說 check。

cards.ex: Is this clinic in network with my insurance?
cards.exz: 這間診所是我保險的特約診所嗎？
cards.note: in-network 較便宜，out-of-network 自付更多。

cards.ex: The snow was almost a foot deep this morning.
cards.exz: 今天早上的積雪快有一英尺深。
cards.note: 複數是 feet；美國人身高、房間大小都用英尺。

cards.ex: He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting.
cards.exz: 他講了個笑話來打破會議上的僵局。
cards.note: 初次見面常用；icebreaker＝破冰小活動或話題。

cards.ex: I'd like my steak medium, please.
cards.exz: 我的牛排要五分熟，麻煩了。
cards.note: M 號也叫 medium；三分熟是 medium rare。

cards.ex: Do you want to hang out this weekend?
cards.exz: 這個週末要不要一起出去玩？
cards.note: 口語；名詞 hangout 指常去聚會的地方。

cards.ex: You have a 10-day grace period to pay without a late fee.
cards.exz: 你有 10 天寬限期，期間繳款不會被收滯納金。
cards.note: 信用卡、保費、房租常見；簽證到期後的緩衝期也用。

cards.ex: I opened a checking account at Chase last week.
cards.exz: 我上週在 Chase 開了一個活存帳戶。
cards.note: 日常收支主帳戶，附金融卡；存錢另開 savings account。

cards.ex: I need to deposit this check at the ATM.
cards.exz: 我要到 ATM 存入這張支票。
cards.note: 名詞也是押金：security deposit＝租屋押金。

cards.ex: Our lease ends in August, so we need to decide soon.
cards.exz: 我們的租約八月到期，得盡快決定。
cards.note: 常見一年期；動詞也可用：lease a car＝長期租車。

cards.ex: Do you want to split a dessert?
cards.exz: 要不要一起分一份甜點？
cards.note: dessert 有兩個 s，重音在後；desert（沙漠）重音在前。

cards.ex: A tornado warning was issued for our county last night.
cards.exz: 昨晚我們這個郡發布了龍捲風警報。
cards.note: watch＝可能生成；warning＝已出現，要立刻躲。

cards.ex: I paid with my debit card at the grocery store.
cards.exz: 我在超市用簽帳金融卡付款。
cards.note: 直接扣你戶頭的錢；credit card 是先刷後繳。

cards.ex: A big thunderstorm is coming this afternoon.
cards.exz: 今天下午會有一場大雷雨。
cards.note: 夏天午後常有；聽到雷聲就該離開泳池和戶外。

cards.ex: That email looks kinda sus. Don't click it.
cards.exz: 那封郵件看起來有點可疑，別點。
cards.note: suspicious 的縮寫，年輕人用語，因 Among Us 流行。

cards.ex: Let's get the nachos as an appetizer.
cards.exz: 我們點個玉米脆片當開胃菜吧。
cards.note: 英國說 starter；份量通常很大，適合分著吃。

cards.ex: I just pay a $30 copay for each doctor visit.
cards.exz: 我每次看醫生只要自付 30 美元。
cards.note: 每次看診固定付；跟要先付滿才理賠的 deductible 不同。

cards.ex: It took me a week to get over the flu.
cards.exz: 我花了一個禮拜才從流感中康復。
cards.note: 感情也能用：get over your ex＝放下前任。

cards.ex: Can you help me set up my new router?
cards.exz: 你可以幫我設定新的路由器嗎？
cards.note: 名詞寫成 setup；set someone up＝設局陷害某人。

cards.ex: I'll have my steak well done, please.
cards.exz: 我的牛排要全熟，謝謝。
cards.note: 也是稱讚：Well done!＝做得好！

cards.ex: Hold on, let me check my calendar.
cards.exz: 等一下，我看一下行事曆。
cards.note: 電話裡也說 Can you hold on a sec?＝請稍等。

cards.ex: Not much, just got off work. You?
cards.exz: 沒什麼，剛下班。你呢？
cards.note: 朋友間打招呼，回 Not much 就行；也可問「怎麼了？」

cards.ex: I'm feeling a little under the weather today.
cards.exz: 我今天覺得有點不舒服。
cards.note: 只用在小不適，像感冒；不用在重病。

cards.ex: I'll take the steak rare, please.
cards.exz: 我的牛排要一分熟，麻煩了。
cards.note: 課本教「罕見」；點牛排時是最生的熟度，中間全紅。

cards.ex: We're going to dress up for my sister's wedding.
cards.exz: 我們要為我姊姊的婚禮盛裝打扮。
cards.note: 萬聖節也用：dress up as a ghost＝扮成鬼。

cards.ex: You need a good credit score to rent this apartment.
cards.exz: 你要有不錯的信用分數才能租這間公寓。
cards.note: 約 300–850 分，租屋、貸款、辦卡都會查。

cards.ex: She hung up on me before I could explain.
cards.exz: 我還沒解釋完，她就掛我電話了。
cards.note: hang up on someone＝不等對方說完就掛電話。

cards.ex: We left a 20% tip for the server.
cards.exz: 我們給了服務生 20% 的小費。
cards.note: 餐廳一般給 18–20%；大桌常已自動加 gratuity。

cards.ex: That burger was amazing, no cap.
cards.exz: 那個漢堡超好吃，真的沒騙你。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；cap＝說謊，所以 no cap＝沒說謊。

cards.ex: Our server just told us about the specials.
cards.exz: 我們的服務生剛剛跟我們介紹了今日特餐。
cards.note: 現在多說 server，不分男女；小費就是給他們。

cards.ex: I'll have the ribeye medium rare.
cards.exz: 我要肋眼牛排，三分熟。
cards.note: 點牛排時店員會問：How would you like it cooked?

cards.ex: Did you see her dance? She totally ate.
cards.exz: 你有看到她跳舞嗎？她簡直神級演出。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，常說 ate and left no crumbs。

cards.ex: I can claim my daughter as a dependent on my taxes.
cards.exz: 我可以把女兒列為報稅的受扶養人。
cards.note: 報稅時列為 dependent 可減稅；形容詞是「依賴的」。

cards.ex: My primary doctor referred me to a specialist.
cards.exz: 我的家庭醫師把我轉介給專科醫師。
cards.note: 看專科常要先有家庭醫師開的 referral（轉診單）。

cards.ex: Eight bucks for a coffee? That's a total rip-off.
cards.exz: 一杯咖啡八塊美金？這根本是敲竹槓。
cards.note: 口語；動詞是 rip someone off＝坑某人。

cards.ex: We saw lightning and heard thunder, so we went inside.
cards.exz: 我們看到閃電又聽到雷聲，就進屋裡了。
cards.note: 不可數名詞；一道閃電說 a bolt of lightning。

cards.ex: The landlord asked for a $1,500 security deposit.
cards.exz: 房東要求 1,500 美元的押金。
cards.note: 通常是一個月房租；退租時扣掉損壞費再退。

cards.ex: TBH, I didn't like the movie that much.
cards.exz: 老實說，那部電影我沒那麼喜歡。
cards.note: to be honest 的縮寫，簡訊常用；也可念 T-B-H。

cards.ex: My paycheck comes by direct deposit every other Friday.
cards.exz: 我的薪水每隔一個週五直接匯進帳戶。
cards.note: 新工作要填銀行的 routing number 和帳號。

cards.ex: Can I get bacon on the side with my pancakes?
cards.exz: 鬆餅可以另外加一份培根嗎？
cards.note: 成語 bring home the bacon＝賺錢養家。

cards.ex: My visa expires in March, so I need to renew it.
cards.exz: 我的簽證三月到期，得去更新。
cards.note: 類別如 B-2（觀光）、F-1（學生）；也是信用卡品牌。

cards.ex: A hurricane is heading toward Florida this weekend.
cards.exz: 這個週末有颶風朝佛羅里達襲來。
cards.note: 分 1 到 5 級；大西洋颶風季是 6 到 11 月。

cards.ex: Can I get a slice of apple pie with ice cream?
cards.exz: 我可以點一片蘋果派配冰淇淋嗎？
cards.note: 加冰淇淋叫 à la mode；美國感恩節餐桌常見。

cards.ex: I stan this band so hard.
cards.exz: 我超愛這個樂團，是死忠粉。
cards.note: 出自 Eminem 歌曲〈Stan〉；也當名詞：a Taylor stan。

cards.ex: I need to pick up my prescription at CVS.
cards.exz: 我要去 CVS 拿我的處方藥。
cards.note: 處方箋縮寫 Rx，藥局招牌上常看到。

cards.ex: California has been in a drought for three years.
cards.exz: 加州已經乾旱三年了。
cards.note: 常見 drought restrictions＝限水規定，例如限制澆草坪。

cards.ex: Please send me the report ASAP.
cards.exz: 請盡快把報告寄給我。
cards.note: 催促語氣偏強，禮貌上常搭 please；常念 A-S-A-P。

cards.ex: Do you have any vegetarian options on the menu?
cards.exz: 菜單上有素食選項嗎？
cards.note: 美國 vegetarian 通常含蛋奶；完全純素要說 vegan。

cards.ex: I pulled a muscle in my thigh at the gym.
cards.exz: 我在健身房拉傷了大腿肌肉。
cards.note: 超市的 chicken thighs 就是去骨雞腿排。

cards.ex: Would you like a beverage while you wait?
cards.exz: 您等的時候想喝點飲料嗎？
cards.note: 比 drink 正式，常出現在菜單、機上服務。

cards.ex: My symptoms started three days ago.
cards.exz: 我的症狀是三天前開始的。
cards.note: 看診時醫師會先問：What are your symptoms?

cards.ex: I need a referral to see a dermatologist.
cards.exz: 我需要轉診單才能看皮膚科。
cards.note: HMO 保險通常要家庭醫師開 referral，PPO 常不用。

cards.ex: A blizzard shut down the whole city last winter.
cards.exz: 去年冬天一場暴風雪讓整座城市停擺。
cards.note: Blizzard warning＝暴風雪警報，通常會停課停班。

cards.ex: You slayed that presentation today!
cards.exz: 你今天的簡報太神了！
cards.note: 原意是「殺」，年輕人用語＝表現亮眼；常單說 Slay!

cards.ex: You can't come tonight? Bummer.
cards.exz: 你今晚不能來？真可惜。
cards.note: 很口語；What a bummer! 或單說 Bummer. 都行。

cards.ex: There was a light drizzle this morning.
cards.exz: 今天早上下著毛毛雨。
cards.note: 料理也用：drizzle with honey＝淋上蜂蜜。

cards.ex: My bank charged me a $35 overdraft fee.
cards.exz: 銀行向我收了 35 美元的透支費。
cards.note: 戶頭餘額不足還刷出去，會被收 overdraft fee。

cards.ex: Stop being such a simp and just text her.
cards.exz: 別再當舔狗了，直接傳訊息給她。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，帶貶意；動詞用法：simp for someone。

cards.ex: This ramen is bussin, you have to try it.
cards.exz: 這碗拉麵超好吃，你一定要試試。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，多半形容食物；也拼成 bussin'。

cards.ex: Last night at that diner was wild. IYKYK.
cards.exz: 昨晚在那間餐館真的太瘋了，懂的都懂。
cards.note: If you know, you know 的縮寫，常用在社群貼文。

cards.ex: I don't want to take on any more projects right now.
cards.exz: 我現在不想再接更多專案了。
cards.note: 也指僱用：The store took on two new cashiers.

cards.ex: I try to work out at the gym three times a week.
cards.exz: 我盡量一週去健身房運動三次。
cards.note: 也有「順利解決」：Things will work out.＝會沒事的。

cards.ex: Let's go over the contract before you sign it.
cards.exz: 簽名之前，我們先把合約仔細看一遍。
cards.note: 也可指「過去拜訪」：I'll go over to his place.

cards.ex: He never showed up for his appointment.
cards.exz: 他根本沒去赴約。
cards.note: No-show＝訂了位或預約卻沒出現，可能被收費。

cards.ex: Do you have change for a $20 bill?
cards.exz: 你有可以換開 20 美元鈔票的零錢嗎？
cards.note: 課本教「改變」；Keep the change.＝不用找了。

cards.ex: I have to hand in my report by Friday.
cards.exz: 我星期五前得交報告。
cards.note: 美國也常說 turn in，如 turn in your homework。

cards.ex: Excuse me, what are the specials for tonight?
cards.exz: 不好意思，今晚有哪些特餐？
cards.note: 服務生常口頭介紹，不在菜單上，記得問價錢。

cards.ex: Your new sneakers are fire.
cards.exz: 你的新球鞋超酷。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；That song is fire.＝這首歌超好聽。

cards.ex: Can you turn up the volume? I can't hear it.
cards.exz: 可以調大聲一點嗎？我聽不到。
cards.note: 也有「出現」：She turned up late.＝她很晚才到。

cards.ex: I didn't want to bring up money at dinner.
cards.exz: 我不想在晚餐時提到錢的事。
cards.note: 美國養小孩多說 raise a kid，bring up 較少用。

cards.ex: She turned down the job offer from Google.
cards.exz: 她拒絕了 Google 的工作邀約。
cards.note: 也指調小：turn down the volume；反義是 turn up。

cards.ex: The hotel put a $200 hold on my credit card.
cards.exz: 飯店在我的信用卡上暫扣了 200 美元。
cards.note: 飯店、租車、加油站常見；幾天後才解除，不是真扣款。

cards.ex: I need to return this shirt. It doesn't fit.
cards.exz: 我想退這件襯衫，尺寸不合。
cards.note: Return policy＝退貨規定；多數店要帶收據。

cards.ex: They broke up after dating for two years.
cards.exz: 他們交往兩年後分手了。
cards.note: 訊號不好時也說：You're breaking up.＝你的聲音斷掉了。

cards.ex: Let's order room service instead of going out.
cards.exz: 我們叫客房送餐吧，不要出去吃了。
cards.note: 要另付服務費和送餐費，價格通常比外面貴。

cards.ex: That outfit? It's giving old money.
cards.exz: 那套穿搭？給人老錢風的感覺。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，後面接氛圍：It's giving 90s vibes.

cards.ex: LOL, I can't believe he actually said that.
cards.exz: 哈哈，真不敢相信他真的這樣說。
cards.note: Laugh out loud 的縮寫；訊息裡常只是緩和語氣。

cards.ex: My grandmother lives on her Social Security check.
cards.exz: 我奶奶靠社會安全年金過活。
cards.note: 報稅、開戶、工作要用 SSN（社會安全號碼）。

cards.ex: She absolutely served in that red dress.
cards.exz: 她穿那件紅洋裝簡直氣場全開。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，常說 serve looks＝穿搭氣場全開。

cards.ex: The job offers great benefits, including health insurance.
cards.exz: 這份工作福利很好，包括健康保險。
cards.note: 常含健保與 401(k) 退休金；面試可問 benefits。

cards.ex: Wanna grab tacos after class? Bet.
cards.exz: 下課要不要去吃塔可？好啊。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，單獨回一個 Bet. 就是「沒問題」。

cards.ex: Can you check my account balance, please?
cards.exz: 可以請你幫我查一下帳戶餘額嗎？
cards.note: ATM 選單的 Check Balance＝查詢餘額。

cards.ex: She walked in with total main character energy.
cards.exz: 她一走進來就自帶主角光環。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，形容自信得像人生主角；有時帶點調侃。

cards.ex: I'll take my steak medium well.
cards.exz: 我的牛排要七分熟。
cards.note: 比 medium 熟、比 well done 嫩；中間只剩一點粉紅。

cards.ex: Can I take a rain check? I'm super tired tonight.
cards.exz: 可以改天嗎？我今晚真的好累。
cards.note: 原指雨天取消的球賽票；商店缺貨時也發 rain check。

cards.ex: My boss blew up at me over a small mistake.
cards.exz: 我老闆為了一個小錯誤對我大發雷霆。
cards.note: 社群上也指爆紅：His video blew up overnight.

cards.ex: A flat tire forced us to pull onto the shoulder.
cards.exz: 爆胎讓我們不得不把車停到路肩。
cards.note: 課本教「肩膀」；路牌 Shoulder Closed＝路肩封閉。

cards.ex: A heat wave is pushing temperatures above 105°F this week.
cards.exz: 這週熱浪來襲，氣溫飆到 105°F 以上。
cards.note: 美國氣溫用華氏：105°F 約 41°C。

cards.ex: We're applying for a mortgage to buy our first house.
cards.exz: 我們正在申請房貸，要買第一棟房子。
cards.note: t 不發音（唸 MOR-gij）；最常見的是 30 年期。

cards.ex: I'm so grateful for your help this week.
cards.exz: 我非常感謝你這週的幫忙。
cards.note: 感恩節常輪流說：I'm grateful for …

cards.ex: Please enter your PIN to complete the payment.
cards.exz: 請輸入您的密碼以完成付款。
cards.note: 刷卡機要你輸入 PIN（通常 4 位數）；讀作 pin。

cards.ex: He was rushed to the ER after the car accident.
cards.exz: 車禍後他被緊急送到急診室。
cards.note: 非危急的小病可去 urgent care，ER 帳單貴很多。

cards.ex: The wedding reception starts at 6 p.m. downtown.
cards.exz: 婚宴晚上 6 點在市區開始。
cards.note: 飯店櫃檯美國多說 front desk，reception 偏英式。

cards.ex: Some people say that movie is too woke.
cards.exz: 有些人說那部電影太在意社會議題了。
cards.note: 原本是正面，現在常被拿來諷刺；政治敏感，別亂用。

cards.ex: This coffee tastes way too bitter.
cards.exz: 這杯咖啡苦得太過頭了。
cards.note: 也指天氣刺骨：bitter cold＝刺骨的寒冷。

cards.ex: These shoes only cost forty bucks.
cards.exz: 這雙鞋才 40 塊美金。
cards.note: buck＝一塊錢；口語多用複數：a few bucks。

cards.ex: We went through customs after picking up our bags.
cards.exz: 領完行李後，我們通過了海關。
cards.note: 先過 immigration（入境審查），領行李後再過 customs。

cards.ex: Let's just chill at home tonight.
cards.exz: 今晚我們就在家放鬆吧。
cards.note: 口語；Chill out!＝冷靜點。

cards.ex: You have to yield to pedestrians at the crosswalk.
cards.exz: 在斑馬線前你得禮讓行人。
cards.note: 倒三角形的 Yield 標誌＝前方要禮讓；英國說 give way。

cards.ex: The thunder was so loud that it woke the baby.
cards.exz: 雷聲大到把寶寶吵醒了。
cards.note: 數閃電到雷聲的秒數，約每 5 秒＝1 英里。

cards.ex: I think I aced the interview today.
cards.exz: 我覺得我今天面試表現超好。
cards.note: ace a test＝考得超好；網球的 ace＝發球直接得分。

cards.ex: I'll take the mild salsa, please.
cards.exz: 我要不辣的莎莎醬，麻煩了。
cards.note: 辣度常分 mild／medium／hot；也可形容暖冬。

cards.ex: I bought a used car, and it turned out to be a lemon.
cards.exz: 我買了台二手車，結果是台瑕疵車。
cards.note: 各州有 lemon law，新車屢修不好可要求換車退款。

cards.ex: The forecast says it'll rain all weekend.
cards.exz: 預報說整個週末都會下雨。
cards.note: 也可當動詞「預測」；看天氣常說 check the forecast。

cards.ex: The farmers market is open every Saturday, come rain or shine.
cards.exz: 農夫市集每週六都開，風雨無阻。
cards.note: 常放句尾，也可只說 rain or shine。

cards.ex: Don't forget to bring your passport to the airport.
cards.exz: 別忘了帶護照去機場。
cards.note: 美國國內線登機要查 REAL ID 或護照。

cards.ex: We pitched our tent next to the lake.
cards.exz: 我們在湖邊搭起了帳篷。
cards.note: 搭帳篷說 pitch a tent；國家公園營地常需提早預訂。

cards.ex: I put $5,000 into a one-year certificate of deposit.
cards.exz: 我把 5,000 美元存進一年期的定期存單。
cards.note: 常簡稱 CD（跟光碟同字母）；提前解約會被罰利息。

cards.ex: I've had a bad cough for a week.
cards.exz: 我已經咳得很厲害，咳了一個禮拜。
cards.note: 動詞名詞同形；cough drops＝喉糖，藥局和超市都有。

cards.zh: 老人醫療保險（65 歲以上）
cards.ex: My father switched to Medicare when he turned 65.
cards.exz: 我爸滿 65 歲後改用聯邦老人醫療保險。
cards.note: 聯邦辦理，別跟低收入用的 Medicaid 搞混。

cards.ex: I'd like a refund for this broken blender.
cards.exz: 我想為這台壞掉的果汁機退款。
cards.note: 常見陷阱：有些店只退 store credit（店內購物金）。

cards.ex: I'll show you my boarding pass on my phone.
cards.exz: 我用手機給你看登機證。
cards.note: 安檢和登機口都要給人看；手機電子版也可以。

cards.ex: Hail damaged the roof of our car last night.
cards.exz: 昨晚冰雹把我們的車頂砸壞了。
cards.note: 動詞也指招手叫車：hail a cab＝攔計程車。

cards.ex: Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
cards.exz: 收據留著，以防你要退貨。
cards.note: p 不發音（唸 rɪˋsit）；退貨通常要出示。

cards.ex: My landlord fixed the leaking sink this morning.
cards.exz: 我房東今天早上修好了漏水的水槽。
cards.note: 大型公寓常由管理公司的 property manager 出面。

cards.ex: Turn left at the next intersection by the gas station.
cards.exz: 在下一個十字路口、加油站旁左轉。
cards.note: 地址常寫成路口：the corner of 5th and Main。

cards.ex: I feel overwhelmed by all this paperwork.
cards.exz: 這些文件讓我不知所措。
cards.note: 工作太多時也說 swamped（更口語）。

cards.ex: The pharmacy closes at 9 p.m. tonight.
cards.exz: 藥局今晚 9 點打烊。
cards.note: CVS、Walgreens 是連鎖藥局，也賣日用品和零食。

cards.ex: The humidity in Houston is brutal in the summer.
cards.exz: 休士頓夏天的濕度高得嚇人。
cards.note: 天氣預報用百分比表示；說 It's humid.＝好悶。

cards.ex: Tenants must give 30 days' notice before moving out.
cards.exz: 房客搬走前必須提前 30 天通知。
cards.note: 跟 landlord（房東）相對；租約上會寫 tenant。

cards.ex: She qualified for Medicaid after losing her job.
cards.exz: 她失業後符合了聯邦醫療補助的資格。
cards.note: 聯邦與各州合辦，給低收入者；各州資格規定不同。

cards.ex: He's still salty that he lost the game.
cards.exz: 他輸了比賽，到現在還在不爽。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，為小事不爽或吃醋；本義是「鹹的」。

cards.ex: The doctor said the MRI needs prior authorization.
cards.exz: 醫師說這個核磁共振需要保險事前核可。
cards.note: 常簡稱 PA 或 prior auth；沒核可保險可能拒付。

cards.ex: We always have pumpkin pie at Thanksgiving.
cards.exz: 我們感恩節一定吃南瓜派。
cards.note: 感恩節經典甜點；常配 whipped cream（鮮奶油）。

cards.ex: Don't spill the beans about the surprise party!
cards.exz: 別把驚喜派對的事說出去！
cards.note: 說漏嘴；類似說法 let the cat out of the bag。

cards.ex: The dentist found two cavities at my checkup.
cards.exz: 牙醫在檢查時發現我有兩顆蛀牙。
cards.note: 也指體腔：chest cavity＝胸腔。

cards.ex: Nice jacket! Your drip is crazy today.
cards.exz: 好帥的外套！你今天這身穿搭太狂了。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；本義是「滴」，從 hip-hop 圈流行開來。

cards.ex: We went to an all-you-can-eat buffet in Las Vegas.
cards.exz: 我們去了拉斯維加斯的吃到飽自助餐。
cards.note: t 不發音（唸 buh-FAY）；all-you-can-eat＝吃到飽。

cards.ex: It's really humid today, and my shirt is sticking to me.
cards.exz: 今天好悶熱，我的衣服都黏在身上了。
cards.note: 更口語的說法是 muggy。

cards.ex: He forgot his own birthday party, SMH.
cards.exz: 他居然忘了自己的生日派對，真是無言。
cards.note: shaking my head 的縮寫；表示無奈、失望，常用在簡訊。

cards.ex: I'll have the 10-piece chicken nuggets, please.
cards.exz: 我要 10 塊雞塊，麻煩了。
cards.note: 點速食說 6-piece 或 10-piece；通常附沾醬。

cards.ex: I'd like a biscuit with gravy for breakfast.
cards.exz: 早餐我想點一份淋肉汁的比司吉。
cards.note: 不是英式的餅乾 biscuit；美國的餅乾叫 cookie 或 cracker。

cards.ex: We stayed in a hostel in Boston to save money.
cards.exz: 為了省錢，我們住在波士頓的青年旅館。
cards.note: 多是共用上下舖的房間；別跟 hotel 搞混。

cards.ex: I'll have the steak with mashed potatoes.
cards.exz: 我要牛排配馬鈴薯泥。
cards.note: 感恩節和炸雞餐的配菜，常淋 gravy（肉汁）。

cards.ex: It's 90 degrees Fahrenheit outside right now.
cards.exz: 外面現在是華氏 90 度。

cards.ex: We roasted marshmallows over the campfire.
cards.exz: 我們在營火上烤棉花糖。
cards.note: 露營經典：s'mores＝烤棉花糖夾餅乾與巧克力。

cards.ex: It's going to be overcast all day tomorrow.
cards.exz: 明天整天都會是陰天。
cards.note: 預報用語；partly cloudy＝局部多雲。

cards.ex: Please RSVP by Friday so we know how many are coming.
cards.exz: 請在週五前回覆是否出席，我們好估人數。
cards.note: 出自法文 répondez s'il vous plaît；邀請函上常見。

cards.ex: IMHO, the first movie was way better.
cards.exz: 依我淺見，第一集好看多了。
cards.note: 較舊的網路用語，論壇和留言區常見。

cards.ex: It started to sleet on our way home.
cards.exz: 回家的路上開始下起雨夾雪。
cards.note: 雨夾雪或凍雨，路面容易結冰，開車要小心。

cards.ex: Can I get a side of cornbread with my chili?
cards.exz: 我的辣豆醬可以加點一份玉米麵包嗎？
cards.note: 南方料理常見，通常帶點甜味，配 BBQ 或 chili。

cards.ex: Always use the crosswalk when you cross the street.
cards.exz: 過馬路一定要走斑馬線。
cards.note: 英國說 pedestrian crossing；美國車要禮讓行人。

cards.ex: I only went to the party because of FOMO.
cards.exz: 我去那場派對純粹是因為怕錯過。
cards.note: fear of missing out 的縮寫；念成 FOH-moh，像一個字。

cards.ex: I'll have a BLT on toast with a side of fries.
cards.exz: 我要烤吐司的 BLT，配薯條。
cards.note: bacon, lettuce, tomato 的縮寫；diner 菜單常見。

cards.ex: For my entrée, I'll have the grilled salmon.
cards.exz: 我的主菜要烤鮭魚。
cards.note: 法國與英國菜單的 entrée 是前菜，美國才是主菜。

cards.ex: After the deductible, I pay 20% coinsurance.
cards.exz: 付完自付額後，剩下的費用我要自付 20%。
cards.note: 按百分比自付；copay 是固定金額，兩者不同。

cards.ex: He has so much rizz that he got her number in five minutes.
cards.exz: 他撩妹超強，五分鐘就拿到她的電話。
cards.note: charisma 的縮略；牛津字典 2023 年度詞。

cards.ex: Let me look up the address on my phone.
cards.exz: 我用手機查一下地址。
cards.note: 也指好轉：Things are looking up.＝情況在好轉。

cards.ex: I've always looked up to my older sister.
cards.exz: 我一直很敬佩我姊姊。
cards.note: 反義是 look down on someone＝瞧不起。

cards.ex: We got lost and ended up in a small town.
cards.exz: 我們迷路了，結果到了一個小鎮。
cards.note: 後面可接 -ing：end up paying＝最後還是付了。

cards.ex: Please put out your cigarette before you come in.
cards.exz: 進來之前請把香菸熄掉。
cards.note: 也指擺出去：put out the trash＝把垃圾拿出去放。

cards.ex: I'm looking for a pair of running shoes.
cards.exz: 我在找一雙跑鞋。
cards.note: 店員、櫃台、客服的開場白；只是看看可答 Just looking.

cards.ex: He's so based for saying what everyone was thinking.
cards.exz: 他敢說出大家心裡想的，真的很猛。
cards.note: 網路用語，讚揚敢說敢做；意思常隨使用者立場而異。

cards.ex: He's always showing off his new car.
cards.exz: 他老是在炫耀他的新車。
cards.note: 名詞 show-off＝愛炫耀的人。

cards.ex: They called off the game because of the storm.
cards.exz: 因為暴風雨，比賽被取消了。
cards.note: 指原本安排好的活動、行程；預約取消較常用 cancel。

cards.ex: Hit me up when you get to town.
cards.exz: 你到鎮上時再找我。
cards.note: 口語：hit me up＝找我、傳訊息給我。

cards.ex: That new menu was a home run with customers.
cards.exz: 新菜單大受客人歡迎，大成功。
cards.note: 棒球術語；也比喻「大成功」：hit a home run。

cards.ex: I don't want to let my team down.
cards.exz: 我不想讓我的團隊失望。
cards.note: 名詞 letdown＝令人失望的事。

cards.ex: My car insurance policy renews next month.
cards.exz: 我的汽車保險保單下個月續約。
cards.note: 課本多教「政策」；店家的 return policy＝退貨規定。

cards.ex: Sorry, I got held up at work.
cards.exz: 抱歉，我被工作耽擱了。
cards.note: 名詞 holdup＝持槍搶劫；Hold up!＝等一下。

cards.ex: Not much. I just started a new job.
cards.exz: 沒什麼，我剛開始一份新工作。
cards.note: 朋友同事間的招呼，簡短回答就好。

cards.ex: That meme is so funny, I'm dead.
cards.exz: 這個迷因太好笑了，我笑死。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，誇張說法；不是真的出事。

cards.ex: The doctor wants me to follow up in two weeks.
cards.exz: 醫師要我兩週後回診追蹤。
cards.note: 名詞 follow-up 指回診、後續追蹤，email 也常用。

cards.ex: Add one cup of flour and mix well.
cards.exz: 加入一杯麵粉，攪拌均勻。
cards.note: 食譜用量單位；量杯叫 measuring cup。

cards.ex: We're watching football at Mike's house on Sunday.
cards.exz: 我們週日要去 Mike 家看美式足球。
cards.note: 美國的 football 是美式足球，足球叫 soccer。

cards.zh: 扣繳申報表（新進員工填）
cards.ex: I filled out a W-4 on my first day at work.
cards.exz: 我上班第一天填了 W-4 表格。
cards.note: 新工作要填，決定薪水預扣多少稅；年底收到 W-2。

cards.ex: The clinic accepts walk-in patients until 5 p.m.
cards.exz: 這間診所到下午 5 點都接受免預約的病人。
cards.note: walk-in clinic＝免預約診所，比 ER 便宜。

cards.ex: I can't figure out how this app works.
cards.exz: 我搞不懂這個 app 怎麼用。
cards.note: 口語很常用，比 understand 更像「摸索後弄懂」。

cards.ex: A truck cut me off on the freeway this morning.
cards.exz: 今天早上有台卡車在高速公路上突然切到我前面。
cards.note: 也可指打斷別人說話：Don't cut me off.

cards.ex: She almost passed out from the heat.
cards.exz: 她差點熱到昏倒。
cards.note: 也指發放：pass out flyers＝發傳單。

cards.ex: I'm beat. Let's call it a night.
cards.exz: 我累壞了，今晚就到這裡吧。
cards.note: 口語；beat 當形容詞才是「累」，動詞是「打」。

cards.ex: The kitchen has a big island with bar stools.
cards.exz: 這間廚房有個大中島，旁邊有吧檯椅。
cards.note: 看房廣告常見：kitchen island；課本教「島嶼」。

cards.ex: Feel free to drop by anytime this weekend.
cards.exz: 這個週末隨時歡迎順道來坐坐。
cards.note: 不必先約；也說 stop by 或 swing by。

cards.ex: Go ahead and order. I'm still deciding.
cards.exz: 你先點吧，我還在想。
cards.note: 回答 Do you mind if I …? 時，Go ahead＝請便。

cards.ex: Can you drop me off at the airport?
cards.exz: 你可以送我到機場嗎？
cards.note: 還車、送小孩上學也用：drop off the kids。

cards.ex: I need to hit the books this weekend.
cards.exz: 這個週末我得好好用功讀書了。
cards.note: 美國學生常說，考前衝刺時用。

cards.ex: I need to buy car insurance before I can drive.
cards.exz: 我得先買汽車保險才能開車。
cards.note: 多數州強制要有汽車責任險，租車也要確認。

cards.ex: A 20% service charge is added for parties of six or more.
cards.exz: 六人以上的團體會加收 20% 服務費。
cards.note: 帳單已含時不必再多給小費，先看清楚。

cards.ex: The pharmacy is two blocks down on the left.
cards.exz: 藥局往前走兩個街區，在左手邊。
cards.note: 美國城市問路不用公尺，用 blocks 算距離。

cards.ex: Can I pay by card, or is it cash only?
cards.exz: 我可以刷卡嗎，還是只收現金？
cards.note: 小店可能 cash only；也可問 Do you take cards?

cards.ex: Let's grab coffee and catch up this weekend.
cards.exz: 這個週末去喝杯咖啡敘敘舊吧。
cards.note: 也指趕上進度：I need to catch up on emails.

cards.ex: Can I exchange this sweater for a bigger size?
cards.exz: 我可以把這件毛衣換成大一號的嗎？
cards.note: 換貨是 exchange，退錢是 refund，店員會問你要哪種。

cards.ex: The host said our table would be ready in ten minutes.
cards.exz: 帶位人員說我們的桌位十分鐘後準備好。
cards.note: 進餐廳先到 host stand（帶位台）報名；也可當動詞「主辦」。

cards.ex: We got a flat tire on the way to Vegas.
cards.exz: 我們去拉斯維加斯的路上爆胎了。
cards.note: 飲料也能說 flat：the soda went flat＝汽水氣跑光了。

cards.ex: I filed an appeal after my claim was denied.
cards.exz: 我的理賠被拒後，我提出了申訴。
cards.note: 被拒賠不要放棄，多數保險都有 appeal 流程。

cards.ex: The temperature dropped to 20°F last night.
cards.exz: 昨晚氣溫掉到華氏 20 度。
cards.note: 98.6°F 是正常體溫；100.4°F 以上算發燒。

cards.ex: Let's fill up the tank before we hit the highway.
cards.exz: 上高速公路前，先把油加滿吧。
cards.note: Fill it up.＝加滿；美國多數加油站是自助。

cards.ex: Pizza at midnight just hits different.
cards.exz: 半夜吃披薩就是特別對味。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，指某件事在這個情境下特別有感覺。

cards.ex: This is Kevin Chen. I'm calling about my appointment.
cards.exz: 我是 Kevin Chen，我打來是想問我的預約。
cards.note: 接電話的人或櫃台會問；回答 This is＋名字。

cards.ex: The gas station is about two miles from here.
cards.exz: 加油站離這裡大約兩英里。
cards.note: 1 mile 約 1.6 公里；限速牌是 mph（英里／小時）。

cards.ex: Get in the right lane. Our exit is coming up.
cards.exz: 靠右車道，我們的出口快到了。
cards.note: carpool lane＝共乘專用道，人數不夠會被開罰。

cards.ex: We have a small yard with a garden in the back.
cards.exz: 我們後面有個小院子，還有一塊菜園。
cards.note: yard sale＝在自家院子辦的二手拍賣。

cards.ex: I have a tight feeling in my chest.
cards.exz: 我胸口覺得很悶。
cards.note: 看診常說 chest pain（胸痛）；也指箱子：toy chest。

cards.ex: I only eat fast food once in a blue moon.
cards.exz: 我難得才吃一次速食。
cards.note: 字面是藍月（約 2–3 年一次），口語指「很少很少」。

cards.ex: Can I get a tall iced latte, please?
cards.exz: 我要一杯小杯冰拿鐵，麻煩了。
cards.note: Tall 12 oz、Grande 16 oz；Tall 不是最大杯。

cards.ex: That's cap. You never beat him at chess.
cards.exz: 你唬爛，你根本沒贏過他下棋。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；no cap＝沒騙你；課本教「帽子、蓋子」。

cards.ex: The company managed to weather the storm of the recession.
cards.exz: 公司成功撐過了經濟衰退的難關。
cards.note: weather 在這裡是動詞「撐過」，不是天氣。

cards.ex: I'll meet you in the parking lot in five minutes.
cards.exz: 我五分鐘後在停車場跟你碰面。
cards.note: 英國說 car park；美國路邊停車叫 street parking。

cards.ex: I have an upset stomach after lunch.
cards.exz: 我午餐後胃不太舒服。
cards.note: 美國人說 stomach 常指整個肚子，不只是胃。

cards.ex: Don't worry, the exam was a piece of cake.
cards.exz: 別擔心，那場考試輕而易舉。
cards.note: 也說 easy as pie＝易如反掌。

cards.ex: Let's go Dutch on dinner tonight.
cards.exz: 今晚晚餐我們各付各的吧。
cards.note: 結帳時直接說 Separate checks, please. 最清楚。

cards.ex: He ghosted me after our third date.
cards.exz: 我們第三次約會後，他就突然消失了。
cards.note: 常用在交友軟體；名詞 ghosting＝人間蒸發。

cards.ex: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what happened.
cards.exz: 別再拐彎抹角了，直接告訴我發生什麼事。
cards.note: 常用祈使句：Don't beat around the bush.＝有話直說。

cards.ex: She's been on cloud nine since she got the job.
cards.exz: 自從拿到那份工作，她就樂翻天了。
cards.note: 字面是「在第九朵雲上」，形容飄飄然的開心。

cards.ex: I lost ten pounds after I started running.
cards.exz: 我開始跑步後瘦了十磅。
cards.note: 縮寫 lb，1 磅約 0.45 公斤；體重、肉類都用磅。

cards.ex: I sent the documents by registered mail.
cards.exz: 我用掛號寄出這些文件。
cards.note: 較常見的是 Certified Mail；Registered 用於貴重物品。

cards.ex: Our flight leaves from Terminal 3.
cards.exz: 我們的班機從第 3 航廈出發。
cards.note: 大機場有多個 terminal；先確認航廈再叫車。

cards.ex: The office was quiet, but it felt like the calm before the storm.
cards.exz: 辦公室很安靜，但感覺像暴風雨前的寧靜。

cards.ex: Could you turn on the AC? It's so hot in here.
cards.exz: 可以開冷氣嗎？這裡好熱。
cards.note: AC＝air conditioning；租屋廣告常寫 central AC。

cards.ex: I sent the down payment by wire transfer.
cards.exz: 我用電匯付了頭期款。
cards.note: 詐騙集團常要求電匯，匯出後很難追回。

cards.ex: Once I hit my out-of-pocket maximum, insurance pays 100%.
cards.exz: 我一達到自付額上限，保險就全額給付。
cards.note: 不含保費；超過上限，該年度承保項目由保險全付。

cards.ex: I'm still looking for a Halloween costume.
cards.exz: 我還在找萬聖節的變裝服。
cards.note: Halloween 是變裝大日；公司、學校常有 costume party。

cards.ex: I went to urgent care for my sprained ankle.
cards.exz: 我扭傷腳踝，去了急症診所。
cards.note: 比 ER 便宜；胸痛、呼吸困難這類要直接去 ER。

cards.ex: I always feel anxious before a job interview.
cards.exz: 面試前我總是很緊張。
cards.note: 比 nervous 更偏持續的擔心；看診會被問到。

cards.ex: I need to schedule a checkup with my primary care physician.
cards.exz: 我要跟我的家庭醫師預約健康檢查。
cards.note: 常簡稱 PCP；HMO 保險通常要先看 PCP 才能轉診。

cards.ex: It's 25°F, but the wind chill makes it feel like 10°F.
cards.exz: 氣溫是華氏 25 度，但風寒讓人覺得像 10 度。
cards.note: 預報的 Feels like 就是體感溫度；冬天以它為準。

cards.ex: Are you pulling my leg? You won the lottery?
cards.exz: 你在跟我開玩笑吧？你中樂透了？
cards.note: 有人說驚人消息時，可回 You're pulling my leg!

cards.ex: It's freezing outside. Wear a coat.
cards.exz: 外面冷死了，穿件外套。
cards.note: 冰點是 32°F；口語 It's freezing! 常是誇張說法。

cards.ex: OMG, I can't believe we won tickets!
cards.exz: 天啊，我不敢相信我們抽中票了！
cards.note: oh my God 的縮寫；簡訊、口語都常用。

cards.ex: I'm shook. I didn't expect that ending.
cards.exz: 我嚇到了，沒想到結局是那樣。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；原是 shake 的過去式（震動）。

cards.ex: We're driving to my aunt's house for Thanksgiving.
cards.exz: 我們要開車去阿姨家過感恩節。
cards.note: 11 月第四個週四；前後幾天機場和公路特別擠。

cards.ex: I'll wait for you in the hotel lobby.
cards.exz: 我在飯店大廳等你。
cards.note: 也當動詞「遊說」：lobby Congress＝向國會遊說。

cards.ex: Michael Jordan is the GOAT, no doubt.
cards.exz: 麥可喬丹就是史上最強，毫無疑問。
cards.note: greatest of all time 的縮寫；念成 goat（山羊）。

cards.ex: He has a small scar on his chin.
cards.exz: 他的下巴上有一道小疤。
cards.note: Chin up!＝打起精神！

cards.ex: I was furious when they canceled my flight.
cards.exz: 他們取消我的班機時，我氣炸了。
cards.note: 比 angry 強很多，是氣到快爆炸。

cards.ex: She gave me a kiss on the cheek.
cards.exz: 她親了我的臉頰一下。

cards.ex: Pants sizes in the U.S. are measured by waist and length.
cards.exz: 美國褲子的尺寸用腰圍和褲長來標示。
cards.note: 標示 32x30＝腰圍 32 吋、褲長 30 吋。

cards.ex: Let's take the elevator to the fifth floor.
cards.exz: 我們搭電梯到五樓吧。
cards.note: 英國說 lift；美國的 1 樓是 first floor。

cards.ex: Does this restaurant have any vegan options?
cards.exz: 這間餐廳有純素的選項嗎？
cards.note: vegan 不含任何動物製品；vegetarian 可能含蛋奶。

cards.ex: Pretty good, thanks. How about you?
cards.exz: 還不錯，謝謝。你呢？
cards.note: 打招呼用，簡短回答 Good, you? 就行。

cards.ex: I'm thrilled to join the team.
cards.exz: 我很高興能加入這個團隊。
cards.note: 職場常用：I'm thrilled to meet you.

cards.ex: I love the vibe at this coffee shop.
cards.exz: 我超愛這間咖啡店的氛圍。
cards.note: 也說 good vibes；I got a weird vibe.＝感覺怪怪的。

cards.ex: I'm exhausted, so I'm going to hit the sack.
cards.exz: 我累壞了，我要去睡了。
cards.note: 口語；類似說法 hit the hay。

cards.ex: The nurse checked my forehead for a fever.
cards.exz: 護理師摸了摸我的額頭看有沒有發燒。
cards.note: 也常念成 FOR-id，h 不發音。

cards.ex: There's an ATM next to the grocery store.
cards.exz: 超市旁邊有一台自動提款機。
cards.note: 用別家銀行的 ATM 常被收手續費；先找自家銀行的。

cards.ex: I bumped my elbow on the door.
cards.exz: 我的手肘撞到門了。
cards.note: 疫情後流行 elbow bump（碰手肘）代替握手。

cards.ex: My car insurance renewal notice came in the mail.
cards.exz: 我的汽車保險續保通知寄到了。
cards.note: 駕照、保險、租約、訂閱服務都用 renewal。

cards.ex: Please keep your luggage with you at all times.
cards.exz: 請隨時把行李帶在身邊。
cards.note: 不可數名詞；領行李的地方叫 baggage claim。

cards.ex: Can I get a 16-ounce iced coffee?
cards.exz: 我要一杯 16 盎司的冰咖啡。
cards.note: 縮寫 oz；飲料的 fl oz（液量盎司）約 30 毫升。

cards.ex: I signed up for a plan on the health insurance marketplace.
cards.exz: 我在健康保險交易平台上投保了一個方案。
cards.note: ACA（歐巴馬健保）的投保平台；有固定開放投保期。

cards.ex: Visibility was only a quarter mile in the fog.
cards.exz: 起霧時能見度只有四分之一英里。
cards.note: 霧、暴風雪警報常寫 low visibility＝低能見度。

cards.ex: Gas is about four dollars a gallon here.
cards.exz: 這裡的汽油大約一加侖四塊美金。
cards.note: 油價、牛奶都用加侖計；1 gallon 約 3.8 公升。

cards.ex: Always bring a map and compass when you hike.
cards.exz: 健行時一定要帶地圖和指南針。
cards.note: 手機內建 Compass app 也能用。

cards.w: Every cloud has a silver lining.
cards.r: ˋɛvɚɪ klaʊd hæz ə ˋsɪlvɚ ˋlaɪnɪŋ
cards.ex: I got laid off, but I found a better job. Every cloud has a silver lining.
cards.exz: 我被裁員了，但找到更好的工作。禍中有福。
cards.note: 安慰人時說；也可只說 silver lining（一線希望）。

cards.ex: He's always flexing his new watch on Instagram.
cards.exz: 他老是在 Instagram 上炫耀新手錶。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；本義是「彎曲」，在健身房也指秀肌肉。

cards.ex: I pulled a calf muscle while running.
cards.exz: 我跑步時拉傷了小腿肌肉。
cards.note: l 不發音；複數 calves；也指小牛。

cards.ex: IMO, we should leave before it gets dark.
cards.exz: 依我看，我們該在天黑前離開。
cards.note: in my opinion 的縮寫；簡訊、留言常用。

cards.ex: I have seasonal allergies every spring.
cards.exz: 我每年春天都有季節性過敏。
cards.note: 看診、填表常被問：Do you have any allergies?

cards.ex: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project.
cards.exz: 我沒有餘力再接另一個專案了。
cards.note: 職場黑話；原指網路頻寬，I'm out of bandwidth＝我沒空了。

cards.ex: We stayed home because it was raining cats and dogs.
cards.exz: 雨下得像倒水一樣，所以我們待在家。
cards.note: 更日常的說法是 It's pouring.＝下大雨。

cards.ex: The hiking trail leads to a high plateau.
cards.exz: 這條健行步道通往一片高原。
cards.note: 也指停滯期：hit a plateau＝撞牆期。

cards.ex: The UV index is 9 today, so wear sunscreen.
cards.exz: 今天紫外線指數是 9，要擦防曬。
cards.note: 天氣 app 都有；8 以上算 very high，要擦防曬。

cards.ex: The catcher threw the ball to second base.
cards.exz: 捕手把球傳向二壘。
cards.note: 棒球術語；The Catcher in the Rye 是《麥田捕手》。

cards.ex: That video is so cringe. I can't watch it.
cards.exz: 那支影片太尷尬了，我看不下去。
cards.note: 年輕人用語；原是動詞「畏縮」，替人感到尷尬。

cards.ex: The roads are icy, so drive carefully.
cards.exz: 路面結冰了，開車要小心。
cards.note: 冬天路況警示常見 icy roads＝路面結冰。

cards.ex: The hotel has great amenities, including a pool and gym.
cards.exz: 這間飯店設施很棒，有游泳池和健身房。
cards.note: 訂房網站會列出 amenities，如泳池、早餐、Wi-Fi。

cards.ex: The baby vomited twice after lunch.
cards.exz: 寶寶午餐後吐了兩次。
cards.note: 口語更常說 throw up；病歷、醫師用 vomit。

cards.ex: I'll pick you up at arrivals around 7 p.m.
cards.exz: 我晚上 7 點左右到入境大廳接你。
cards.note: 機場看板分 Arrivals（抵達）與 Departures（出發）。

cards.ex: An avalanche closed the mountain road yesterday.
cards.exz: 昨天雪崩讓山路封閉了。
cards.note: 滑雪區會發 avalanche warning（雪崩警報），要遵守。

cards.ex: Can I get extra gravy on the side?
cards.exz: 可以另外多給一點肉汁醬嗎？
cards.note: 感恩節火雞、炸雞排都淋它；biscuits and gravy 是早餐。

cards.ex: Tomorrow will be partly cloudy with a high of 75°F.
cards.exz: 明天晴時多雲，最高溫華氏 75 度。
cards.note: 預報也會出現 mostly sunny（大致晴朗）。

cards.ex: Check the expiration date before you buy the milk.
cards.exz: 買牛奶前先看一下有效期限。
cards.note: 食品多寫 Best by（賞味期）；信用卡是 MM/YY。

cards.ex: I'm quitting my job tomorrow. JK!
cards.exz: 我明天要辭職了。開玩笑的啦！
cards.note: just kidding 的縮寫；簡訊常用，不是日本的 JK。

cards.ex: My grandma makes the best stuffing every Thanksgiving.
cards.exz: 我奶奶每年感恩節做的麵包填料最好吃。
cards.note: 烤在火雞外面的常叫 dressing，南方尤其常見。

cards.ex: Do you have a flashlight? The power just went out.
cards.exz: 你有手電筒嗎？剛剛停電了。
cards.note: 英國說 torch；美國的 torch 是火把或噴槍。

cards.ex: I'll have two eggs, bacon, and hash browns.
cards.exz: 我要兩顆蛋、培根和薯餅。
cards.note: 美式早餐配菜，常問你要 hash browns 還是 toast。

cards.ex: We've been chatting online for months but never met IRL.
cards.exz: 我們在網路上聊了好幾個月，但從沒在現實見過面。
cards.note: in real life 的縮寫；常用來區分線上和線下。

cards.ex: Wildfire smoke created a thick haze over the city.
cards.exz: 野火的煙在城市上空形成一層濃霾。
cards.note: 野火煙霧或空汙造成；空氣品質看 AQI 指數。

cards.ex: It's been gloomy all week. I miss the sun.
cards.exz: 整週都陰陰的，我好想念太陽。
cards.note: 可形容天氣，也可形容人心情低落。

cards.ex: I named my wife as the beneficiary of my life insurance.
cards.exz: 我把太太列為人壽保險的受益人。
cards.note: 開戶、保險、退休金帳戶都要指定 beneficiary。

cards.ex: She was ecstatic when she got into medical school.
cards.exz: 她考上醫學院時欣喜若狂。
cards.note: 比 thrilled 還強，幾乎是狂喜。

cards.ex: My paycheck is smaller because of tax withholding.
cards.exz: 因為預扣稅款，我的薪水變少了。
cards.note: 薪資單的 Federal withholding；W-4 決定預扣多少。

cards.ex: Can I get a short stack of pancakes with syrup?
cards.exz: 我可以點一份小疊鬆餅，配楓糖漿嗎？
cards.note: short stack＝一小疊（約 2 到 3 片）。

cards.ex: It's 25 degrees Celsius, which is about 77 degrees Fahrenheit.
cards.exz: 現在是攝氏 25 度，大約華氏 77 度。
cards.note: 美國日常幾乎都用華氏，Celsius 多見於科學、醫療。

cards.ex: Departures is on the upper level of the terminal.
cards.exz: 出境大廳在航廈的樓上。
cards.note: 送機在 Departures 層下車，接機在 Arrivals 層。

cards.ex: Could we get some extra napkins, please?
cards.exz: 可以多給我們一些餐巾紙嗎？
cards.note: 擦嘴用的叫 napkin；面紙才叫 tissue。

cards.ex: The hotel offers valet parking for $40 a night.
cards.exz: 這間飯店提供代客泊車，一晚 40 美元。
cards.note: 取車時通常要給服務員 $2 到 $5 的小費。

cards.ex: The concierge recommended a great Italian restaurant.
cards.exz: 禮賓人員推薦了一家很棒的義大利餐廳。
cards.note: 可幫忙訂餐廳、叫車、買票；通常也要給小費。

cards.ex: I lost my wallet, then my car broke down. When it rains, it pours.
cards.exz: 我錢包掉了，車又壞了。真是禍不單行。
cards.note: 壞事接連來時說；字面是「一下雨就傾盆大雨」。

cards.ex: My mortgage payment includes an escrow account for property taxes.
cards.exz: 我的房貸月付款包含代管帳戶，用來付房屋稅。
cards.note: 貸款機構幫你代收房屋稅與保險費，再代為繳納。

cards.ex: He was treated for hypothermia after falling through the ice.
cards.exz: 他掉進冰窟後，因失溫接受治療。

cards.ex: That text about my package looks like a phishing scam.
cards.exz: 那則包裹通知簡訊看起來像網路釣魚詐騙。
cards.note: 唸起來像 fishing；銀行不會用簡訊要你輸入密碼。

cards.ex: My mom makes meatloaf with mashed potatoes every Sunday.
cards.exz: 我媽每個週日都做烤肉糕配馬鈴薯泥。
cards.note: 美式家常菜，常淋番茄醬汁；diner 菜單常見。

cards.ex: I had to give my SSN to open a bank account.
cards.exz: 我開銀行帳戶時得提供社會安全號碼。
cards.note: 地位像身分證字號；除非必要，別隨便給人。

cards.ex: We hiked into the backcountry for three days.
cards.exz: 我們健行進入荒野區走了三天。
cards.note: 國家公園進去過夜通常要申請 backcountry permit。

cards.ex: Your AGI determines whether you qualify for the credit.
cards.exz: 你的調整後總收入決定你能不能享有這項抵稅額。
cards.note: 報稅軟體常要你輸入去年的 AGI 來驗證身分。

cards.ex: I'll start with a bowl of clam chowder.
cards.exz: 我先來一碗蛤蜊巧達濃湯。
cards.note: 新英格蘭式是奶白色；舊金山常用酸種麵包碗盛。

cards.ex: Who wants to make s'mores by the fire?
cards.exz: 有誰要在營火邊做棉花糖夾心餅？
cards.note: 全麥餅乾夾烤棉花糖與巧克力；名稱源自 some more。

cards.ex: Everything in the store is BOGO this weekend.
cards.exz: 這個週末店裡全部買一送一。
cards.note: 也有 BOGO 50% off＝第二件半價，要看清楚。

cards.ex: Your application must have a postmark by April 15.
cards.exz: 你的申請書最晚要在 4 月 15 日前蓋上郵戳。
cards.note: 報稅、申請截止常以郵戳日為準，不是收到日。

cards.ex: Your insurance formulary lists which drugs are covered.
cards.exz: 你的保險藥物給付清單列出了有給付的藥。
cards.note: 藥物分級（tier）不同，自付額也不同。

cards.ex: LMK if you can make it tomorrow.
cards.exz: 你明天能來的話跟我說一聲。
cards.note: let me know 的縮寫；簡訊、Slack 最常見。

cards.ex: I highkey need a vacation right now.
cards.exz: 我現在超級需要放個假。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，lowkey 的反義；毫不掩飾地強調。

cards.ex: Skinny jeans are so cheugy now.
cards.exz: 現在穿窄管褲太跟不上時代了。
cards.note: 唸 chew-gee；Z 世代用語，笑別人老土又愛跟風。

cards.ex: You can bring your SO to the company party.
cards.exz: 你可以帶另一半來參加公司派對。
cards.note: significant other 縮寫；不分性別、婚否的伴侶。

cards.ex: I can't make out what the sign says from here.
cards.exz: 我從這裡看不清楚標誌寫了什麼。
cards.note: 注意：口語 make out 也可指親熱接吻。

cards.ex: He wanted to get back at his brother for breaking his game console.
cards.exz: 他想報復弟弟弄壞他的遊戲機。
cards.note: 後面接人：get back at someone；口語也說 get even。

cards.ex: I finally gave in and bought the kids a puppy.
cards.exz: 我最後讓步了，買了隻小狗給孩子們。
cards.note: 常搭 to：give in to temptation＝抵擋不住誘惑。

cards.ex: She really takes after her mother.
cards.exz: 她真的很像她媽媽。
cards.note: 可指外貌或個性像上一輩，不能用在同輩。

cards.ex: Look out for black ice on the road tonight.
cards.exz: 今晚要小心路上的黑冰。
cards.note: 也指照顧：I look out for my little brother.

cards.ex: The host said, "Right this way," and led us to a booth.
cards.exz: 帶位人員說「這邊請」，帶我們到一個卡座。
cards.note: 餐廳帶位時說；跟著走就好，不需要回答。

cards.ex: Let's go through the checklist one more time.
cards.exz: 我們把檢查清單再仔細過一遍。
cards.note: 也指經歷困難：She went through a divorce.

cards.ex: I'll look into it and get back to you.
cards.exz: 我來查查看，再回覆你。
cards.note: 客服常說：I'll look into it.＝我幫您查查。

cards.ex: Don't look down on people just because they're poor.
cards.exz: 別因為人家窮就瞧不起人。
cards.note: 反義是 look up to＝尊敬。

cards.ex: She pointed out a mistake in my report.
cards.exz: 她指出我報告裡的一個錯誤。
cards.note: 後面常接 that：point out that…＝指出…。

cards.ex: I keep putting off my dentist appointment.
cards.exz: 我一直拖著不去看牙醫。
cards.note: 被動 be put off by＝對…反感。

cards.ex: We ordered a three-course dinner.
cards.exz: 我們點了三道菜的晚餐。
cards.note: main course＝主菜；課本教「課程」，這裡指一道菜。

cards.ex: Everything was delicious. Could we get the check, please?
cards.exz: 每樣都很好吃。可以麻煩結帳嗎？
cards.note: 服務生會在用餐中或用餐後問；有問題也可以直接說。

cards.ex: We set off for Yellowstone at 6 a.m.
cards.exz: 我們早上 6 點出發去黃石公園。
cards.note: 也指觸發：The toast set off the smoke alarm.

cards.ex: A: This traffic is awful. B: You can say that again!
cards.exz: A：這塞車也太誇張了。B：你說得再對不過了！
cards.note: 表示非常同意；不是真的要你再說一次。

cards.ex: Let's get together for dinner next week.
cards.exz: 下週我們聚餐吧。
cards.note: 名詞 get-together＝小型聚會。

cards.ex: I ran into my old boss at the grocery store.
cards.exz: 我在超市巧遇以前的老闆。
cards.note: 也指遇到問題：run into trouble＝碰上麻煩。

cards.ex: My bank account has been in the red since the move.
cards.exz: 搬家之後，我的帳戶一直是透支的。
cards.note: 反義是 in the black＝有盈餘；帳簿上赤字用紅字。

cards.ex: Please don't leave out any details on the form.
cards.exz: 表格上請不要漏掉任何細節。
cards.note: feel left out＝覺得被排擠。

cards.ex: I finally paid off my student loans last year.
cards.exz: 我去年終於還清了學生貸款。
cards.note: 也指有回報：Hard work pays off.＝努力有回報。

cards.ex: I paid the rent with a money order from the post office.
cards.exz: 我用郵局買的匯票付了房租。
cards.note: 沒支票戶頭時的替代品；郵局、超市都買得到。

cards.ex: Yes, I'll have a cheeseburger and a Coke.
cards.exz: 好，我要一個起司漢堡和一杯可樂。
cards.note: 還沒決定可回：Give us a few more minutes.

cards.ex: He always puts his coworkers down in meetings.
cards.exz: 他總在會議上貶低同事。
cards.note: 名詞 put-down＝貶低人的話。

cards.ex: I got my flu shot at the pharmacy yesterday.
cards.exz: 我昨天在藥局打了流感疫苗。
cards.note: 美國藥局可直接打 flu shot；也指一小杯烈酒。

cards.ex: Getting that parking spot was a huge W.
cards.exz: 搶到那個停車位簡直大獲全勝。
cards.note: 年輕人用語，win 的縮寫；反義是 L（loss）。

cards.ex: Missing the last train home was a huge L.
cards.exz: 錯過回家的末班車，真是大輸特輸。
cards.note: loss 的縮寫，W 的反義；芝加哥高架列車叫 the L。

cards.ex: There's road work on the highway, so expect delays.
cards.exz: 高速公路在施工，預計會塞車。
cards.note: 橘色路標 Road Work Ahead；施工區超速罰款常加倍。

cards.ex: My employer mailed me my W-2 in January.
cards.exz: 我的雇主一月就把 W-2 寄給我了。
cards.note: 報稅必備，雇主 1 月底前要寄出；接案收入是 1099。

cards.ex: My doctor told me to cut down on salt.
cards.exz: 醫師叫我少吃一點鹽。
cards.note: 後面接名詞或 -ing：cut down on drinking。

cards.ex: I'll get this round. What are you drinking?
cards.exz: 這一輪我請，你們喝什麼？
cards.note: 輪流請客：It's my round.；酒吧裡常見。

cards.ex: We're going to eat in, not take it to go.
cards.exz: 我們要內用，不外帶。
cards.note: 也說 For here；外帶說 To go 或 takeout。

cards.ex: Hey, do you have a minute to talk?
cards.exz: 嘿，你有空聊一下嗎？
cards.note: 跟朋友、同事都可用；對陌生人先用 Excuse me。

cards.ex: A hit-and-run driver damaged my parked car.
cards.exz: 一個肇事逃逸的駕駛撞壞了我停著的車。
cards.note: 在美國是刑事罪；撞到停著的車也要留下聯絡資料。

cards.w: Can I have the check, please?
cards.r: kæn aɪ hæv ðə tʃɛk pliz
cards.ex: Can I have the check, please? I'll pay by card.
cards.exz: 麻煩給我帳單，我用刷卡。
cards.note: 美國餐廳在座位上結帳；也可簡單說 Check, please.

cards.ex: No, that's all for now. Thanks!
cards.exz: 不用了，目前這樣就好，謝謝！
cards.note: 店員、服務生常問；點完後回 That's all 結束點餐。

cards.ex: Can you help me pick out a gift for my mom?
cards.exz: 你可以幫我挑一份送媽媽的禮物嗎？
cards.note: 也指辨認：pick out someone in a crowd＝在人群中認出。

cards.ex: I signed up for a yoga class at the gym.
cards.exz: 我在健身房報名了一堂瑜珈課。
cards.note: 名詞 sign-up 指報名單；網站「註冊」也用。

cards.ex: Is there an outlet where I can charge my phone?
cards.exz: 哪裡有插座可以幫手機充電？
cards.note: 也指收費：charge $5 for parking＝停車收 5 元。

cards.ex: Despite being famous, she's very down-to-earth.
cards.exz: 雖然很有名，她一點架子也沒有。
cards.note: 稱讚人務實、平易近人；常見於人物介紹。

cards.ex: We should hit the road before traffic gets bad.
cards.exz: 我們該在塞車前上路。
cards.note: 公路旅行常用；Let's hit the road.＝出發吧。

cards.ex: He dropped out of college after his first year.
cards.exz: 他大一念完就輟學了。
cards.note: 名詞 dropout＝輟學的人；也指退出比賽或計畫。

cards.ex: May I speak with Dr. Lee, please?
cards.exz: 請問李醫師在嗎？
cards.note: 打電話找人的禮貌說法；對方會回 Speaking.＝我就是。

cards.ex: Our coach told us to arrive an hour early.
cards.exz: 教練要我們提早一小時到。
cards.note: 機票艙等的 coach 是經濟艙；也當動詞「指導」。

cards.ex: Let's meet at the bar after work for happy hour.
cards.exz: 下班後我們去酒吧趁優惠時段喝一杯吧。
cards.note: 常在傍晚，飲料和小菜特價；實際時段各店不同。

cards.ex: I'd like to return this. I have the receipt.
cards.exz: 我想退這個，我有收據。
cards.note: 櫃台退貨時說；店員會問原因、是否有收據。

cards.ex: May I speak with Dr. Chen? — Speaking.
cards.exz: 請問陳醫師在嗎？——我就是。
cards.note: 電話裡對方找的就是你時回；不必說 I am。

cards.ex: Watch your step. The stairs are wet.
cards.exz: 小心腳下，樓梯是濕的。
cards.note: 常見於階梯、地面濕滑處的標示；也當叮嚀說。

cards.ex: Sorry to interrupt. Please carry on.
cards.exz: 抱歉打斷了，請繼續。
cards.note: 名詞 carry-on＝登機隨身行李，機場很常聽到。

cards.ex: Watch out for black ice on the bridge tonight.
cards.exz: 今晚橋面要小心黑冰。
cards.note: 透明、看不見，路面看起來只是濕的，特別危險。

cards.ex: You can order ahead on the Starbucks app.
cards.exz: 你可以用星巴克的 app 提前點餐。
cards.note: 美國店家常用 app 點餐、付款、領優惠券。

cards.w: I'd like to open an account.
cards.r: aɪd laɪk tu ˋopən æn əˋkaʊnt
cards.ex: I'd like to open a checking account, please.
cards.exz: 我想開一個活存帳戶，麻煩了。
cards.note: 銀行會要護照與住址證明，常也要 SSN 或 ITIN。

cards.ex: The police officer told me to pull over.
cards.exz: 警察要我靠邊停車。
cards.note: 被警察攔下時，保持雙手放在方向盤上別下車。

cards.w: like a fish out of water
cards.r: laɪk ə fɪʃ aʊt ʌv ˋwɔtɚ
cards.ex: I felt like a fish out of water at the fancy party.
cards.exz: 在那場高級派對上，我渾身不自在。
cards.note: 剛到新環境、新公司時很好用。

cards.ex: I usually buy fresh produce at the farmers market.
cards.exz: 我通常在農夫市集買新鮮蔬果。
cards.note: 超市蔬果區叫 produce section；動詞是 prəˋdus。

cards.ex: I opened my account at a local credit union.
cards.exz: 我在本地的信用合作社開了戶。
cards.note: 會員制非營利，手續費常比大銀行低；要符合入會資格。

cards.ex: He missed the game because of a knee injury.
cards.exz: 他因為膝蓋受傷缺席了比賽。
cards.note: 保險、職災常見：work injury＝工傷。

cards.ex: She's mad at me for being late.
cards.exz: 她氣我遲到。
cards.note: 美國 mad＝生氣，英國才是「瘋」；東岸俚語 mad good＝超好。

cards.ex: Spill the tea! What happened at the party?
cards.exz: 快說八卦！派對上發生什麼事？
cards.note: 年輕人用語，常說 spill the tea＝爆料；課本教「茶」。

cards.ex: Do I need to transfer to another bus?
cards.exz: 我需要轉乘別班公車嗎？
cards.note: 名詞 transfer 是轉乘票；銀行轉帳也用這個字。

cards.ex: We drove through a beautiful valley in Utah.
cards.exz: 我們開車穿過猶他州一個美麗的山谷。
cards.note: Silicon Valley＝矽谷；Death Valley 是國家公園。

cards.ex: I always warm up before I run.
cards.exz: 我跑步前一定先熱身。
cards.note: 也指加熱剩菜：warm up the leftovers。

cards.ex: The game kicks off at 7:30 p.m. on Sunday.
cards.exz: 比賽週日晚上 7:30 開球。
cards.note: 名詞 kickoff＝開球；也指活動、專案的啟動。

cards.ex: I took out a loan to buy my first car.
cards.exz: 我貸款買了我的第一台車。
cards.note: 常搭 take out a loan；student loan＝學生貸款。

cards.ex: Is there a faster route to the airport?
cards.exz: 有沒有比較快的路線可以到機場？
cards.note: 美國唸 root 或 rowt 都可以；公路編號像 Route 66。

cards.ex: Can I get a turkey sub with extra lettuce?
cards.exz: 我要一個火雞肉潛艇堡，生菜多一點。
cards.note: 各地叫法不同：hoagie、hero、grinder 都是它。

cards.ex: Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
cards.exz: 請填寫這張表格，並在下方簽名。
cards.note: 英式常說 fill in；美式 fill out 更常見。

cards.ex: Can I see your ID, please?
cards.exz: 可以看一下你的證件嗎？
cards.note: 買酒、進酒吧都要查 ID，通常是駕照或 state ID。

cards.ex: Hang on a second. I'm almost done with this.
cards.exz: 等一下，我快做完了。
cards.note: 更口語的 hold on；坐車時喊 Hang on! 是「抓緊」。

cards.ex: I know it's tough, but hang in there.
cards.exz: 我知道很辛苦，但要撐住。
cards.note: 安慰、鼓勵人時說；常在對方遇到難關時用。

cards.ex: My wife and I have a joint account for bills.
cards.exz: 我太太和我有一個聯名帳戶用來付帳單。
cards.note: 夫妻常用；兩人都可以動用全部存款。

cards.ex: What do you recommend for an appetizer?
cards.exz: 你推薦什麼開胃菜？
cards.note: 問服務生；也可問 What's your most popular dish?

cards.ex: I'm working the night shift this week.
cards.exz: 我這週上夜班。
cards.note: pick up a shift＝多接一個班；夜班是 night shift。

cards.ex: The doctor ordered an X-ray of my wrist.
cards.exz: 醫師幫我開了手腕的 X 光檢查。
cards.note: 機場行李安檢機也叫 X-ray machine。

cards.ex: Can I crash on your couch tonight?
cards.exz: 我今晚可以睡你家沙發嗎？
cards.note: 口語；也指電腦當機、車禍撞毀。

cards.zh: 平方英尺（約 36 呎＝1 坪）
cards.ex: Rent here is about $4 per square foot.
cards.exz: 這裡的租金大約每平方英尺 4 美元。
cards.note: 複數 square feet，廣告寫 sq ft；1 坪約 36 平方英尺。

cards.ex: That song has been living rent-free in my head all day.
cards.exz: 那首歌整天在我腦子裡揮之不去。
cards.note: 常說 live rent-free in my head；本義是「免付租金」。

cards.ex: My carry-on bag didn't fit in the overhead bin.
cards.exz: 我的隨身行李放不進頭頂的行李櫃。
cards.note: 另可帶一件 personal item，放在前方座椅下。

cards.ex: Let's split the bill evenly between the four of us.
cards.exz: 我們四個人平分帳單吧。
cards.note: 也說 split the check；各付各的＝separate checks.

cards.ex: It snowed about six inches last night.
cards.exz: 昨晚大約下了六英寸的雪。
cards.note: 1 inch 約 2.5 公分；身高說 5 feet 10 inches。

cards.ex: We waited an hour in line at immigration.
cards.exz: 我們在入境審查排隊排了一小時。
cards.note: 先過 immigration（查護照），領行李後再過海關。

cards.ex: My out-of-pocket costs this year were over $3,000.
cards.exz: 我今年的自付費用超過 3,000 美元。
cards.note: 沒有保險給付的費用；常搭 cost、expense。

cards.ex: Ew, the bathroom was so gross.
cards.exz: 噁，那間廁所超噁心。
cards.note: gross income＝稅前總收入，報稅常見；口語 gross＝噁心。

cards.ex: This trail is about three miles round trip.
cards.exz: 這條步道來回大約三英里。
cards.note: 國家公園的步道起點叫 trailhead（登山口）。

cards.ex: I have to give a pitch to investors on Friday.
cards.exz: 我週五要向投資人做提案簡報。
cards.note: elevator pitch＝30 秒內講完的簡短介紹。

cards.ex: Do you have any organic eggs?
cards.exz: 你們有有機雞蛋嗎？
cards.note: 包裝有 USDA Organic 標章才是認證有機。

cards.ex: Careful, there's a wet floor sign by the restrooms.
cards.exz: 小心，洗手間旁邊立了「小心地滑」的牌子。
cards.note: 黃色立牌，美國賣場、廁所、餐廳都會擺。

cards.ex: I'll have a whiskey on the rocks, please.
cards.exz: 我要一杯加冰塊的威士忌，謝謝。
cards.note: 字面是觸礁；點酒時指加冰塊。不加冰叫 neat。

cards.ex: Always check your blind spot before changing lanes.
cards.exz: 變換車道前一定要看一下死角。
cards.note: 也可比喻想法上的盲點。

cards.ex: Call the front desk if you need extra towels.
cards.exz: 需要多的毛巾就打電話給櫃檯。
cards.note: 毛巾、鑰匙卡、問路都可以找 front desk。

cards.ex: I can't log in to my account.
cards.exz: 我登入不了我的帳號。
cards.note: 也常說 sign in；當名詞或形容詞寫成 login。

cards.ex: We're staying at a beach resort in Maui for a week.
cards.exz: 我們要在茂宜島的海灘度假村住一星期。
cards.note: 訂房常有額外的 resort fee（設施費），看清楚。

cards.ex: I burned my tongue on the hot coffee.
cards.exz: 我被熱咖啡燙到舌頭了。
cards.note: ue 不發音；也指語言，如 mother tongue。

cards.ex: Tell me about your trip. I'm all ears.
cards.exz: 跟我說說你的旅行吧，我洗耳恭聽。
cards.note: 口語，表示你很想聽。

cards.ex: The job pays a salary of $85,000 a year.
cards.exz: 這份工作年薪八萬五千美元。
cards.note: salary 是固定薪水；wages 是按時計酬。

cards.ex: Do you offer a student discount?
cards.exz: 你們有學生折扣嗎？
cards.note: 美國常見 student、senior、military discount，要主動問。

cards.ex: Let's go over the agenda before the meeting starts.
cards.exz: 會議開始前，我們先看一下議程。
cards.note: hidden agenda 指暗藏的盤算。

cards.ex: The kids ate too much candy on Halloween.
cards.exz: 萬聖節那天孩子們吃了太多糖果。
cards.note: 美國說 candy，英國說 sweets；candy bar 是巧克力棒。

cards.ex: Which carrier are you with, Verizon or T-Mobile?
cards.exz: 你用哪家電信，Verizon 還是 T-Mobile？
cards.note: 美國三大電信：Verizon、AT&T、T-Mobile。

cards.ex: I have a blister on the sole of my foot.
cards.exz: 我腳底長了水泡。
cards.note: 與 soul 同音；sole 也是一種魚（鰨魚）。

cards.ex: What do you have on tap tonight?
cards.exz: 你們今晚有什麼生啤酒？
cards.note: 酒吧牆上常有 tap list（生啤酒清單）。

cards.ex: Servers get low hourly wages, so tips matter a lot.
cards.exz: 服務生的時薪很低，所以小費很重要。
cards.note: 通常用複數，指按時計酬的工資；對照 salary。

cards.ex: I need to brush up on my Spanish before the trip.
cards.exz: 出發前我得把西班牙文複習一下。
cards.note: 指複習本來會、但生疏了的東西。

cards.ex: He retired and now lives on his pension.
cards.exz: 他退休了，現在靠退休金過活。
cards.note: 美國另有 401(k)，是自己提撥的退休帳戶。

cards.ex: A winter storm warning is in effect until 6 a.m.
cards.exz: 冬季風暴警報持續到早上六點。
cards.note: watch 是可能發生；warning 是已發生或即將發生。

cards.ex: I don't recognize this transaction on my bank statement.
cards.exz: 我不認得銀行對帳單上這筆交易。
cards.note: 不認得的交易可向銀行 dispute（提出爭議）。

cards.ex: The doctor gave me a diagnosis of strep throat.
cards.exz: 醫生診斷我是鏈球菌喉炎。
cards.note: 複數是 diagnoses，念 -siz。

cards.ex: I'll get the mac and cheese as a side.
cards.exz: 配菜我要起司通心粉。
cards.note: macaroni and cheese 的口語縮寫，兒童餐常見。

cards.ex: Let's wrap up the meeting in five minutes.
cards.exz: 我們五分鐘後結束會議吧。
cards.note: 課本意思是「包起來」；開會常說 wrap up。

cards.ex: Could we have separate checks, please? We're paying individually.
cards.exz: 可以請你們分開開帳單嗎？我們各付各的。
cards.note: check 在美國是帳單；最好點餐時就先講。

cards.ex: The dentist said I need a filling.
cards.exz: 牙醫說我需要補牙。
cards.note: 餐點的「餡料」也叫 filling。

cards.ex: That party last night was so lit!
cards.exz: 昨晚那場派對超嗨的！
cards.note: 年輕人用語；課本只教 light 的過去式。

cards.ex: We got completely wasted at Jake's party.
cards.exz: 我們在傑克的派對上喝得爛醉。
cards.note: 很口語；課本意思是「浪費的」。

cards.ex: The landlord is replacing the old carpet next week.
cards.exz: 房東下週要換掉舊地毯。
cards.note: 整片鋪滿的叫 carpet；rug 是小塊地毯。

cards.ex: My grandfather has type 2 diabetes.
cards.exz: 我爺爺有第二型糖尿病。

cards.ex: Can I get the dressing on the side?
cards.exz: 沙拉醬可以另外放旁邊嗎？
cards.note: 點沙拉會被問 ranch、Italian 等哪種 dressing。

cards.ex: Follow Leave No Trace rules and pack out your trash.
cards.exz: 請遵守無痕山林原則，垃圾自己帶走。
cards.note: 國家公園步道口常見的標語與七大原則。

cards.ex: Do you have liability insurance on your car?
cards.exz: 你的車有投保責任險嗎？
cards.note: 車險的 liability 是賠付對方的損失。

cards.ex: Weddings are the bread and butter of our catering business.
cards.exz: 婚禮是我們外燴生意的主要收入來源。
cards.note: 也可指最基本的東西，如 bread-and-butter issues。

cards.ex: A cold snap is coming, so bring a warm coat.
cards.exz: 寒流要來了，記得帶件保暖的外套。
cards.note: 短暫的驟冷天氣；對照 heat wave（熱浪）。

cards.ex: I've felt depressed ever since I lost my job.
cards.exz: 自從丟了工作，我一直很憂鬱。
cards.note: 口語指心情低落；診斷用 clinical depression。

cards.ex: We hiked along the ridge and watched the sunset.
cards.exz: 我們沿著山脊健行，看著夕陽。
cards.note: 步道和地名常見，如 Blue Ridge。

cards.ex: My wife brings home the bacon while I stay with the kids.
cards.exz: 我太太負責賺錢養家，我在家帶孩子。
cards.note: 口語；字面是把培根帶回家。

cards.ex: Stay behind the fence. The cliff edge is dangerous.
cards.exz: 請待在圍欄後面，懸崖邊很危險。
cards.note: 海邊或河邊的陡坡常叫 bluff。

cards.w: How would you like that cooked?
cards.r: haʊ wʊd ju laɪk ðæt kʊkt
cards.ex: Medium rare, please. A little pink in the middle.
cards.exz: 三分熟，謝謝。中間帶點粉紅色。
cards.note: 點牛排時會被問；medium rare＝三分熟，well done＝全熟。

cards.ex: Bro, that concert was amazing, FR.
cards.exz: 兄弟，那場演唱會真的超棒。
cards.note: for real 的縮寫；傳訊息用語，寫 frfr 更強調。
